followup.noteZh: Nature 正文现已核实 Minecraft 每局随机世界、死亡或 36000 步终止、12 项稀疏奖励物品链，并明确抽象合成和加速破坏方块；移除仅旧预印本支持此设置的限制。各领域仍为重新训练，非单策略零样本泛化。
followup.noteEn: The Nature text verifies random Minecraft worlds, death/36,000-step termination, a twelve-item sparse-reward chain, abstract crafting and accelerated block breaking. The old-preprint-only caveat is removed; domains still involve retraining rather than zero-shot policy transfer.

reviewedScope.en: Metrics and tuning for learning-rule transfer across six platforms

followup.noteZh: Nature 正文/方法核实 Atari57、Procgen16、DMLab30 的归一化 IQM，Crafter/NetHack/Sokoban 平均回报及 95% CI；留出环境只调学习率。迁移对象是学习规则、需重新训练智能体，官方最小代码仅含 Catch，不代表六平台完整复现。
followup.noteEn: Nature Methods specifies normalized IQM for Atari57/Procgen16/DMLab30 and mean return for Crafter/NetHack/Sokoban, with 95% intervals. Held-out tuning varies learning rate only. Transfer concerns retrained learning rules; the minimal public harness contains Catch, not full six-platform reproduction.

reviewedScope.zh: 人类判断/动作的认知模型评价
reviewedScope.en: Cognitive-model evaluation of human judgments/actions

followup.noteZh: Nature 全文核实 1808 局/9892 步的人类动作似然、观看判断的 TVD/JS 距离；与随机对手 120 次自博弈用于计算趣味性特征，并非独立游戏智能体排行榜。因此不新增九维交互任务。
followup.noteEn: The full Nature article evaluates human-action likelihood over 1,808 matches/9,892 moves and TVD/JS for judgments. The 120 self-play runs against random opponents compute funness features, not an independent game-agent benchmark.
